title: Hans's tasks (25th Anniversary task list)
series: 25th Anniversary celebrations (task list available until 31 December 2026)
start: Talk to Hans in the Lumbridge Castle courtyard (talk about the anniversary tasks) to receive the 25th Anniversary task list. The tasks can be completed in any order, but you need the task list with you. After completing all of them, speak to Hans again for the reward.

items.t: Full mime outfit (can be bought from Iffie's Random Costume Shop during the task)
Materials for any Summoning pouch (can be bought from Pikkupstix's Summoning Shop during the task):

recommended.t: Stardust with teleport unlocked, or wicked hood

steps.sec: Route stop 1 of 25: 2001 – Hans Free
steps.t: Talk to Hans about 25th Anniversary tasks.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2001 · content referenced: RuneScape · dialogue NPC: Hans
Dialogue when the task completes (Hans – when you ask him about the anniversary tasks) – from the wiki transcript:
Before receiving a 25th Anniversary task list:
Hans: Oh, hey, I wonder if you'd be interested in helping out on a bit of a nostalgia tour...
Player: A what?
Hans: I've been wandering around this castle for some twenty-five years now, and let me tell you, it's nice to take a break!
Hans: And it got me reminiscing about everything that's happened in that time.
Player: Okay...
Hans: I was planning to wander around Misthalin and Asgarnia, taking in the sights and the memories - things I've seen and done, things adventurers have told me about...
Player: Why do I feel there's about to be a 'but'?
Hans: ...but I've agreed to run this little event, so can't really leave.
Hans: So I thought, maybe, I could live vicariously through you...?
Player: What do you want me to do?
Without free backpack space:
Hans: I have a list of tasks I was planning to complete - talk to me about this again when you have room to take it...
With free backpack space:
You receive: 25th Anniversary task list
Hans: Here's a list of the tasks I was planning to complete - perhaps you could complete it for me?
Message: You put the list inside your backpack.
Player: Wait a second, the first task here says 'Talk to Hans about 25th Anniversary tasks.' - why do I feel like I'm being hoodwinked?
Hans: Shhh, you've started now, so you'll have to finish...but there is a shiny reward in it for you!
Task complete: “Hans Free” – Talk to Hans about 25th Anniversary tasks. (task completion pop-up in the same transcript)

steps.sec: Route stop 1 of 25: 2001 – Hans Free
steps.t: A “25TH ANNIVERSARY TASK” pop-up appears for “Hans Free”.

steps.sec: Route stop 2 of 25: 2002 – Dragon These Bones With Me
steps.t: Have some dragon bones in your backpack (wiki: items needed for this activity).

steps.sec: Route stop 2 of 25: 2002 – Dragon These Bones With Me
steps.t: Show Hans some dragon bones.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2002 · content referenced: Dragon bones (and Dragon Slayer) · dialogue NPC: Hans
Dialogue when the task completes (Hans – using dragon bones on him (first time)) – from the wiki transcript:
Hans: Ah, dragon bones! Now, that takes me way back...
Hans: I once tried to enter the Champions' Guild on one of my walks, but they'd only let me in if I defeated a dragon.
Hans: 'No chance', I thought, so I just went back to my walking.
Task complete: “Dragon These Bones With Me” – Show Hans some dragon bones.
Hans: I'd say you've fared better than I at being a champion, but when it comes to step count, I'm the champion!
If all the tasks have been completed:
Player: Looks like I've completed everything. I'd better go and see Hans about that reward!

Player: Hello, Gower brothers! It's great to see you. I'm feeling nostalgic.
Andrew Gower: Nostalgia is all well and good, but don't get lost in it. Visit the past, but also look to the future!
Paul Gower: This world was once great! For some it has remained great! And for others still, it shall be great once again!
Ian Gower: You're always welcome here where we're at...or you can go old school...or, hey, even visit some wild dragons in the dragon wilds...

steps.sec: Route stop 20 of 25: 2021 – By Guthix, to Orla!
steps.t: Show Orla Fairweather, south-east of Draynor jail, a Divination memory. This can't be completed in Burthorpe or at the Memorial to Guthix.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2021 · content referenced: Divination improvements · dialogue NPC: Orla Fairweather
Dialogue when the task completes (Orla Fairweather) – from the wiki transcript:
Orla Fairweather: Ah, the memories...
Player: And the energies, chronicles and wisps...
Orla Fairweather: Very droll.
Orla Fairweather: But you are right, we should not dwell on the past so much.
Orla Fairweather: Perhaps you are here for me to divine your future...
Player: Well, seeing as I'm here.
Orla Fairweather: Hmm, let me see... You will stand tall and fight back against powerful gods, yet end up triumphant!
Player: Um, all of that is in the past.
Orla Fairweather: Hmm, let me see... You will complete a series of seemingly random, nostalgic tasks in exchange for a shiny reward!
Player: Sorry, no, that's the present.
Orla Fairweather: Hmm, let me see... You will get an elbow in the ribs from an irate diviner.
Task complete: “By Guthix, to Orla!” – Show Orla Fairweather a Divination memory.
Player: Ah, no! Please, spare me from my terrible fate!

steps.sec: Route stop 21 of 25: 2012 – A Lode of Fun
steps.t: Talk to Archmage Sedridor on the 2nd floor [UK] / 3rd floor [US] of the Wizards' Tower.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2012 · content referenced: Lodestone Network · dialogue NPC: Archmage Sedridor
Dialogue when the task completes (Archmage Sedridor) – from the wiki transcript:
Player: Hello, Archmage Sedridor. Might I ask a question about the Lodestone Network?
Archmage Sedridor: Why, of course. How may I be of assistance?
Player: Do you think lodestones have improved everyone's lives or taken away a little bit of its magic?
Archmage Sedridor: Hmm, a peculiar question. They are the height of convenience! They have done wonders for world trade. No doubt, they have spared many ex-walkers untold amounts of foot injury.
Archmage Sedridor: Ah, but true...when does one take the time to casually stroll these days, to take in the sights and the sounds? What wonders we miss when when convenience is at the fore...
Task complete: “A Lode of Fun” – Talk to Archmage Sedridor about the Lodestone Network.
Archmage Sedridor: Indeed, life should be somewhat 'bumpy', for you cannot have the highs without the lows. Thank you for reminding me of such. You know what, I think I'LL go out for a walk soon.
If all the tasks have been completed:
Player: Looks like I've completed everything. I'd better go and see Hans about that reward!

steps.t: Talk to Vannaka the Slayer Master outside Edgeville Dungeon in the southern Edgeville.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2005 · content referenced: Slayer · dialogue NPC: Vannaka
Dialogue when the task completes (Vannaka) – from the wiki transcript:
Player: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to sign one time here, to show I've completed this task.
Vannaka: Got any tips for me?
Player: Last time I completed a task, I used this pen here to check it off my list.
Vannaka: Okay, great!
Task complete: “Slayer!” – Talk to Vannaka the Slayer Master outside Edgeville dungeon, south of Edgeville.
Player: And another task complete!
If all the tasks have been completed:
Player: Looks like I've completed everything. I'd better go and see Hans about that reward!

steps.sec: Route stop 24 of 25: 2005 – Slayer!
steps.t: A “25TH ANNIVERSARY TASK” pop-up appears for “Slayer!”.

steps.sec: Route stop 25 of 25: 2023 – Femurs and Fungi
steps.t: Talk to Malignius Mortifer at the Um ritual site.

sub.t: Wiki task list: year 2023 · content referenced: Necromancy · dialogue NPC: Malignius Mortifer
Dialogue when the task completes (Malignius Mortifer) – from the wiki transcript:
Malignius Mortifer: Er, how much do you like mushrooms, boss?
Player: What have you done now, Malignius?
Malignius Mortifer: My necromancy training isn't going so well. I didn't mean to, but...
Player: But...
Malignius Mortifer: ...but I think I accidentally turned my therapist into a portobello.
Player: You think? How can you not know?
Malignius Mortifer: Well, it might be a porcini.
Player: *sigh* It doesn't matter what kind of mushroom he is, turn him back! If you're not sure how, just ask Death.
Malignius Mortifer: Ah, right, yeah... I'll go talk to *gulp* ...Death. Er, right away, boss.
Player: Do you want me to talk to him for you?
Task complete: “Femurs and Fungi” – Talk to Malignius Mortifer in the City of Um Ritual Site.
Malignius Mortifer: N-no... I'm on it. I just need to psyche myself up first...
If all the tasks have been completed:
Player: Looks like I've completed everything. I'd better go and see Hans about that reward!

steps.sec: Route stop 25 of 25: 2023 – Femurs and Fungi
steps.t: A “25TH ANNIVERSARY TASK” pop-up appears for “Femurs and Fungi”.

steps.sec: Claim the reward
steps.t: After all 25 tasks are done, talk to Hans in Lumbridge Castle courtyard again and ask about the rewards. You receive the 25th Anniversary cape cosmetic override.

sub.t: Hans transcript – “Do you have any rewards for me?” (after completing the list and before claiming the reward):
Hans: I think I have some rewards for you...
Game message: You have unlocked the cosmetic override. '25th Anniversary cape'.
Game message: You can activate this via the 'Wardrobe' tab in the 'Customisations' interface.
Hans: That should be everything! Thanks again for helping me out.

steps.sec: Claim the reward
steps.t: Activate the cape via the ‘Wardrobe’ tab in the ‘Customisations’ interface (the game message in the wiki transcript of Hans). Done!
